subject: Operator training & runbook validation — Borealis private deployment
messages:
From: Borealis Procurement <procurement@borealishealth.com>

Cc: Emma Liu <emma.liu@borealishealth.com>, Samir Patel <samir.patel@borealishealth.com>
Date: Tue, 2 Apr 2028 22:10:00 +0000
Subject: Request: Operator training & runbook validation for private deployment

Hi Marissa,

Thanks again for the run-through last week. As part of our procurement checklist for the private (VPC/on-prem) deployment we need the following evidence to move the contract forward: 

- A validated operator runbook describing day‑to‑day ops, incident playbooks, and rollback procedures.
- Operator training plan and sample materials, plus a template for attendance records and certification criteria.
- Proof of KMS/HSM integration patterns and a high‑level diagram showing key material flows.
- Confirmation that training can be delivered on‑site (US East) and a proposed dry‑run schedule.

Could you share the requested artifacts and a short plan (dates + owners) by EOD Friday? We’ll need them attached to the SOW addendum.

Best,
Procurement Team
Borealis Health

--
This request is on behalf of the Borealis IT procurement committee.

From: marissa_cole@redwood.ai
To: Borealis Procurement <procurement@borealishealth.com>
Cc: Emma Liu <emma.liu@borealishealth.com>, vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai
Date: Wed, 3 Apr 2028 10:15:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: Operator training & runbook validation for private deployment

Hi Emma / Procurement team,

Thanks — we can provide all of that. Attached are two primary artifacts to start: RW-Runbook-v2.pdf (draft, operational procedures + incident playbooks) and operator-training-slides.pptx (sample training deck). I’ve also included a blank training attendance template (training-attendance-template.csv).

Proposed plan:
- Thu 2028-04-06: internal review with your ops lead (dry run). Owner: Vanessa Ortiz (redwood).
- Mon 2028-04-10: on-site operator training (half-day) + hands‑on dry run. Owner: Rishi Malhotra (redwood).
- Tue 2028-04-11: deliver final runbook and attestation PDF for SOW addendum.

We will also share a KMS diagram (kms-evidence-diagram.png) and a short writeup on our HSM/KMS integration model by EOD Thursday. Please confirm whether you need operator certification wording in the SOW (we can supply language).

Attachments: RW-Runbook-v2.pdf (attachment), operator-training-slides.pptx (attachment), training-attendance-template.csv (attachment)

Thanks,
Marissa Cole
Senior Solutions Director | Redwood Inference

Subject: Re: Operator training & runbook validation — technical checklist

Hi all,

I reviewed RW-Runbook-v2.pdf and have a few technical clarifications / asks before we finalize:

1) KMS/HSM: please confirm whether Borealis will provide the HSM endpoint (Yubikey/HSM appliance) in their VPC or whether Redwood will integrate with a cloud KMS tenant. The runbook currently documents both flows but we need to mark which will be used for the initial deployment.

2) Secrets rotation: the runbook references a 30‑day rotation for operator credentials. If Borealis requires FIPS‑based key rotation cadence or additional approval steps, note it in the SOW.

3) Network egress: include your NOC contact and confirm that the on‑prem firewall will allow outbound connections to our control plane IP ranges in the SOW addendum. We’ll provide exact IP blocks and ports (HTTPS 443 + SSH 22 for operator sessions).

4) Evidence: I’m attaching a short KMS diagram and a checklist for the compliance pack. I’ve also added a sample signature block that Borealis can sign for operator training completion.

Links: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1aBcD-example-runbook
DocuSign: https://app.docusign.com/BR-2028-091-addendum

Irene Choi
Principal Infra Engineer | Redwood Inference
irene_choi@redwood.ai

Attachments: kms-evidence-diagram.png (attachment)

Hi Marissa / Vanessa,

Thanks for the quick turnaround — the materials look good. A couple of follow ups before we lock dates: 

- Can you confirm if operator certification is a pass/fail with a written quiz or just attendance + practical signoff? We prefer a clear written acceptance criteria we can reference in the SOW.
- We would like a half‑day on‑site dry run (not just remote) to validate network egress and key wrap policies. Can Redwood provide a list of equipment/ports you need from the on‑prem team?
- Please confirm whether Redwood will perform any cloud control‑plane callbacks during the dry run (we need that documented for our firewall change).

Proposed dates: 2028‑04‑10 or 2028‑04‑11 for the on‑site dry run (we can host). Please let me know which you prefer and we will confirm the operator POC.

Regards,
Emma Liu
IT Procurement Lead | Borealis Health
emma.liu@borealishealth.com

Cc: vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai, irene_choi@redwood.ai, rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai
Date: Fri, 6 Apr 2028 16:00:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Operator training & runbook validation for private deployment

Emma / Samir / Procurement team —

Thanks for the clarifying questions. Final confirmations: 

- Certification: Redwood will require attendance + a short written checklist and a practical signoff from Borealis operator lead. We will provide a 10‑question written checklist; passing requires 8/10 correct OR demonstrated practical completion. We will include the exact wording in the SOW addendum.
- On‑site dry run: Redwood can run a half‑day on‑site dry run on 2028‑04‑10. Vanessa will send calendar invites and logistics. Required ports: HTTPS 443 outbound to control-plane IPs, SSH 22 outbound for operator sessions; we will supply specific IP ranges.
- Control plane callbacks: For the dry run we will initiate authenticated control‑plane callbacks limited to telemetry and KV cache prefetch; no secrets material will leave your environment. We will document exact endpoints and telemetry fields in the final runbook.

Attached: finalized attachments (RW-Runbook-v2.pdf, operator-training-slides.pptx, kms-evidence-diagram.png, training-attendance-template.csv). I will upload the attestation/ack PDF to the DocuSign link for signature once you confirm the SOW language.

Next steps:
1) Emma confirm POC and we’ll schedule the calendar invites (Vanessa).
2) We’ll deliver the SOW addendum language by 2028‑04‑07 for your legal review.

Thanks — looking forward to the dry run.

Marissa Cole
Senior Solutions Director | Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.ai
